title: Algebraic Cipher Types: Confidentiality Trade-offs in Type Constructors over Trapdoor Computing
description: A functorial framework for structured computation over trapdoor encodings. Develops cipher type constructors (sum, product, function) with explicit confidentiality trade-offs, including the orbit-closure bound on what an adversary can learn from cipher value observations. Establishes the encoding-granularity principle: component-wise encoding leaks correlations across cipher values, joint encoding hides them at storage cost growing as |Y|^k. Provides the formal noise-floor analysis for cipher Boolean composition that cipher-maps defers to (the noise propagation under cipher AND, OR, NOT operations on the cipher Boolean partition).
